reasons.detail: R1 — The diff updates `src/flow/prompts/plan/draft-gate.md` to require pre-gate confirmation of `draft.json.approval.approved = true` and `approval.confirmedAt` before `sdd-forge flow run gate --phase draft`, with explicit wording that this is only when no unresolved user decision remains.

R2 — The updated draft-gate guidance only adds explicit approval metadata checks and a non-resolve-user-decision gate; it explicitly forbids proceeding with unresolved `requires_user_decision` and includes no instruction to bypass or relax `DraftApproval.validate()`. The added tests also assert these constraints.

R3 — The diff adds approval metadata guidance directly in `src/flow/prompts/plan/draft-gate.md` and adds a spec-local test that verifies `sdd-forge flow get next-action` for `draft-gate` returns instructions containing that same guidance.
